span.p:
api-gateway
Port: 8080
Spring Cloud Gateway MVC
- Global CORS Enabled
- Actuator: /health, /info, /gateway

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
service-registry
Port: 8761
Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
job-service
Port: 8081
Spring Boot 4.1 / Java 25
- POST /jobs/create
- PUT /jobs/update/{id}
- DELETE /jobs/delete/{id}
- Schedule Calculator (CRON / INTERVAL / ONCE)
- ULID Generation (jobId, eventId)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
job-search-service
Port: 8083
Spring Boot 4.1 / Spring Data JPA
- GET /jobs/{jobId}
- GET /jobs?status&scheduleType
- GET /jobs/{jobId}/runs
- GET /jobs/runs/{runId}
- GET /jobs/runs?status

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Topic: job-commands
Key: jobId (FIFO per Job)
Payload: JobCommand (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Topic: run
Key: jobId
Payload: JobRunEvent / JobRunMessage (attempt, payload, maxRetries)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Topic: job-run-events
Key: runId (FIFO per Run)
Payload: JobRunLifecycleEvent (PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, TIMEOUT, EXECUTOR_DIED)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Topic: retry
Key: jobId
Payload: JobRetryEvent (nextAttempt, retryDelaySeconds, errorMsg)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Topic: dead
Key: jobId
Payload: JobDeadEvent (attempt, maxRetries, errorMsg)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
watcher-service: WatcherScheduler
Port: 8084
@Scheduled(fixedDelay = 20s)
- Polling due jobs batch (batch-size=1000)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
watcher-service: JobTransactionService
- Pessimistic Write Lock (SKIP LOCKED timeout=-2)
- Leases jobs by setting lastPolledTime = now
- Advance Schedule (CRON / INTERVAL / ONCE)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
watcher-service: RunProducer
- Generates new ULID runId
- Emits initial attempt=1 to Kafka

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
job-consumer-service
Port: 8085
Kafka Consumer: job-dispatch-consumer-group
- Consumes 'run' topic
- Emits PENDING lifecycle event to 'job-run-events'
- OpenFeign Client: calls executor-service

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
executor-service
Port: 8086
ExecutorController: POST /executor/run (HTTP 202 Accepted)
- Java 25 Virtual Threads Worker Pool
- Emits RUNNING event
- Timeout Guard (CompletableFuture.orTimeout)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
executor-service: TaskRunner
- HTTP Webhook Task (RestClient POST/GET/etc)
- Simulated Task (durationMs, fail, errorMessage)
- Generic / Text Payload execution

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
executor-service: ExecutorHeartbeatService
@Scheduled(fixedRate = 10s)
- Emits Redis heartbeat TTL = 30s
Key: executor:{id}:heartbeat

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
executor-service: ExecutorEventProducer
- Publishes SUCCESS / FAILED / TIMEOUT to 'job-run-events'
- If attempt < maxRetries: Publishes 'retry' (10s * 2^attempt)
- If attempt >= maxRetries: Publishes 'dead'

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
retry-service: RetryEventConsumer
Port: 8087
Kafka Consumer: retry-service-group
- Consumes 'retry' topic
- Calculates dueTimestampMs = now + delaySeconds
- Atomic Lua Script: Dedup check + ZADD to Redis ZSET

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
retry-service: RetrySweeperService
@Scheduled(fixedDelay = 1000ms)
- Atomic Lua Script: ZRANGEBYSCORE + claim lease (score + 30s)
- Generates new ULID runId for retry attempt
- Publishes JobRunMessage to 'run' topic
- On Kafka Broker ACK: Removes item from Redis ZSET (At-Least-Once)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
consumer-service
Port: 8082
Spring Boot 4.1 / Spring Data JPA

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
JobPersistenceService
- Consumer Group: job-consumer-group
- Deduplicates commands via processed_commands table
- Applies CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE to 'jobs' table

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
JobRunPersistenceService
- Consumer Group: job-run-events-consumer-group
- Consumer Group: job-dead-consumer-group
- Layer 1: Deduplicates eventId via processed_events table
- Layer 2: State Machine Guard (rejects out-of-order/terminal regressions)
- Updates 'job_runs' & manages parent 'jobs' lifecycle

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Table: jobs
- id (ULID PK)
- name, schedule_type, status
- next_run_time, last_polled_time
- cron_expression, payload (jsonb)
- retries (default 3), meta (jsonb)
Indices: idx_schedule_time, idx_watcher_poll

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Table: job_runs
- id (Bigserial PK), run_id (ULID Unique)
- job_id (FK), status, attempt_number
- start_time, end_time, modification_time
- executor_id, execution_time_ms, error_msg
Indices: idx_job_id, idx_status, idx_modification_time

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Key: executor:{id}:heartbeat
Type: String (Timestamp)
TTL: 30 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Key: retry:delayed
Type: Sorted Set (ZSET)
Score: dueTimestampMs
Member: DelayedRetryItem JSON
